messages.subject: longInvariance quiet = TRUE
parts:

longInvariance(model.mi_R,auto=1,constrainAuto = TRUE,varList = constrainedVar,strict = TRUE, data=primar_sem, quiet = TRUE)

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: longInvariance quiet = TRUE
parts: I wanted to use the option (quiet = TRUE) to get a summary containing an overview of the different models that are fitted but nothing is printed.

Right, because you told it to be quiet. So it silently returned the results without printing anything.

Thanks for noticing this.  The description of the quiet= argument in the help page has it backward (also on the ?measurementInvarianceCat help page).  Instead, it works as described on the multiple-group invariance help page:

?measurementInvariance

I'll fix this in the development version.
